svg.title: Core Cloud OpenSearch deployment architecture
svg.desc: A calling root configuration deploys the Core Cloud OpenSearch module from the Terraform CLI or from caller-owned CI using a branch-scoped IAM OIDC role. State is held locally or in a versioned S3 bucket owned by the caller. With no subnet IDs the module creates a public-endpoint OpenSearch domain with an account-principal access policy and optional IP-restricted Dashboards access. Callers that supply private subnet IDs and security group IDs get a VPC endpoint. Log publishing writes to CloudWatch log groups through a log delivery resource policy.
svg.text: core-cloud-opensearch-tf-module — Amazon OpenSearch Service provisioned by Terraform, driven locally or by GitHub Actions
Region and account supplied by the calling configuration
Zone awareness and warm tier off
Created only when access_policy is non-empty
Unsigned browser requests need an approved /32 CIDR
Caller supplies existing private subnet_ids and security_group_ids
Optional HA: zone awareness, dedicated masters,
Module creates no permissive ingress on your behalf
VPN, Direct Connect, or internal proxy
Approved network path required to reach Dashboards
IP-based browser access does not apply in VPC mode
Fine-grained access control, internal user database, custom endpoint + ACM certificate
One log group per enabled log type, optional KMS key, Core Cloud tags applied
Skipped if all log types are off
CloudWatch log groups managed by the module
Merged with Name and optional tags on every module resource
